cards.title: I've Forgotten So Much About Second Baby Care
cards.body: A parent navigates the challenges of raising a second child, realizing how much knowledge from the first baby has faded. Family support helps bridge practical gaps while stirring nostalgic memories of a simpler childhood.

cards.title: Should AI Replace Human Parenting Decisions?
cards.body: Tech companies market eye-tracking tools and 'optimized nap predictions' to parents, promising to optimize child-rearing. The article questions whether these gadgets address real parenting needs or just exploit parental anxiety.

cards.title: The '18 Summers' Parenting Trend Explained
cards.body: Modern parents are turning summer breaks into 'making memories' exercises rather than allowing unstructured downtime. This trend raises concerns about control and whether constant activity actually benefits children.

cards.title: Why Your Quiet Child May Need Extra Help
cards.body: Silent children often hide significant distress that adults miss because their struggle doesn't manifest as obvious behavior. Parents should recognize that withdrawal can signal overwhelming emotions just as much as outbursts do.

cards.title: Launching a College Freshman: Making the Transition
cards.body: The shift from high school to college represents a major developmental milestone requiring intentional support. Understanding this transition helps parents guide their teens through newfound independence.

cards.title: Racial Socialization: Critical Parenting Strategy
cards.body: Black families use racial socialization to help youth navigate systemic realities and discrimination. This protective parenting approach is essential for child safety and emotional resilience.

cards.title: Estranged Adult Children Hear These Wrong Messages
cards.body: Estranged adult children repeatedly hear unhelpful criticism like 'you didn't try hard enough' or 'you're too sensitive.' Understanding these harmful narratives helps parents approach difficult family relationships with more compassion.

cards.title: When Financial Rescues Enable Adult Child Panic
cards.body: Parents who repeatedly bail out adult children during emergencies can inadvertently reinforce anxious patterns. Breaking this cycle requires setting boundaries while maintaining the relationship.

cards.title: Kids' Quiz: Testing Knowledge With Child Questions
cards.body: Children pose creative quiz questions covering everything from penguin flight to bus safety features. Parents can use these playful challenges to engage with their kids' curiosity.
